The goal might be to move the car to the left end so it docks with the container, and then the S inside the container... hmm.

Let me look at the purple dots: 4 purple 2×2 dots at the N/S/E/W centers of the left panel. And the right panel: 3×3 tiles, corners+center gray, edges white.
Hmm, what if the game is: the tail car has two halves (b and S). The bottom panels are "goals": I need to make the top bar's configuration match one of them? The top bar is 4 rows × 31 cols... no.

The tail at cols 17-20 would touch the S block (cols 13-16) via the bar? Actually, the S block is at rows 18-21, cols 13-16; the bar is at rows 19-20, cols 17-38. The tail at cols 17-20, rows 19-22.
Let me just try moving the tail all the way left and observe. Currently the tail is at cols 31-34 (b east, S west). 7 LEFTs to reach cols 17-20. Let me do it and watch for special events (docking, color change, level complete).
Also note: the tail's b half currently faces east (right). If LEFT sets b to face west, then the tail at cols 17-20 would be b left (cols 17-18), S right (cols 19-20).
Let me run LEFT ×7 and print the state after each step, watching for anomalies.
